reconcile.note: Clarke limits God's Genesis rest to the completed work of creation, leaving him still active in sustaining the world, which is the working John 5:17 describes.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible catalogs this pairing as a flat contradiction, since Genesis has God resting from all his work while John shows him working continuously, sabbaths included.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
sides.verseText: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

sides.snippet: My Father is still working, so I am working, too.
sides.verseText: But Jesus answered them, \"My Father is still working, so I am working, too.\"
